general.description: Qoppa was once upon a time... the home of a small familial explorastro company. In their golden years, they discover a lot of things, notably in the Gamma sector. But they where infamous, too, for their catastrophic behaviours during their expeditions, fueling a lot of tales about these "braves awkwards explorastro corps".
general.bar: Veterans from the explorastro Qoppa Corps telling tales about their past glory in some crowded greasy spoon in Qoppa City.
